== Android screen streaming

- Fixed an issue on Android devices where each failed attempt to start the screen stream left an extra virtual display on the device. The virtual display is now released when the screen stream fails to start.

// REVIEWER NOTE (KOB-55457): This fix stops the leftover virtual displays. It does not fix the
// underlying failure that prevents the screen stream from starting on some devices. That failure
// is tracked separately and is still open, so do not describe streaming on those devices as fixed.
// REVIEWER NOTE (KOB-55457): The ticket reports the failure during Lightning Mode attempts, but the
// affected code path may not be limited to Lightning Mode. Confirm with engineering before naming
// Lightning Mode in the entry.
// REVIEWER NOTE (KOB-55457): The ticket does not describe a symptom that users see during a
// session. Confirm the entry belongs in public release notes rather than support notes only.
